'''Chilla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] undercover agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Chilla worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in [[The Rusty Bucket]], a bar in the city of [[Takari]], on [[Iyuta]]. Chilla's affiliation was discovered by the Empire and she was wounded. Chilla hid in the planet's ancient sewer system, eventually [[Death/Legends|dying]] but not before leaving a message on a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] [[recorder]].<ref name="Plant" />

The Empire then replaced Chilla with an [[Chilla (impersonator)|impersonator]], as part of a plot to discover the Rebel headquarters. However, [[Green squad]] from [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]] discovered the real Chilla's corpse while preparing a mission to eavesdrop on a newly built [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|Imperial Communications Center]], blowing the impersonator's sham.<ref name="Plant" />
